items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Kid ran in. Was he in the home? Yeah, we was all in the homes and all the same band.

ctx.x: Well, they had some good people in it, I know from what I hear. Oh, yeah.

And there was shots, shots was in there with shots and little George Washington was on trombone. Jerry was on, I called Jerry to call him. He was on trumpet. And well, drums and them other instruments. Kid ran in. Huh? Yeah, really, they'd come up all under us. Kid ran in. Was he in the home? Yeah, we was all in the homes and all the same band. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I was the instrument cleaner. I wasn't playing nothing, man.
What about Joe Rene? Was he in there? Who was that? Joe Rene. Kid ran in.
